audit_role: interim evidence; not a final 20k behavioral success report

baseline_episode_audit.history_scope: all episode records present at audit scan start; running training continues
baseline_episode_audit.comparison_scope: within baseline run; not matched-progress comparison across configurations

periodic_actor_probe.scope: Initial state only, before any APF/environment step; critic estimates are not actual returns

learner_history.scope: recent learner records at unequal progress, not an outcome ranking

verification_boundaries.automatic_completion_watches: Both existing watches include checkpoint provenance, actual mission behavior and media verification.

periodic_cpu_prefix_probes.scope: Short prefix diagnostics in real CPU UavNetSim; modified controls are probes, not learned-policy fixes or full mission evaluations
limitations: mirror_up modifies control only for diagnosis, not a trained-policy repair
same reset seed 10044, same reward/APF/scenario; later observations diverge after control intervention
short-prefix return is not ground-truth long-horizon Q or mission success

learner_latest_refresh.scope: latest available learner rows; configurations at unequal progress

episode_latest_refresh.scope: recent episode means, unequal training progress; no outcome ranking

latest_periodic_actor_probe.scope: Initial state only, before any APF/environment step; critic estimates are not actual returns

latest_periodic_cpu_prefix_probe.scope: 24-step prefix of actual deterministic actor in real CPU UavNetSim; not full mission evaluation
